top_issues: Legend under total balance ('On-chain $0.00', 'Reserve $40.00', 'Secured $0.00') uses identical green square swatches for three distinct states, making bar segment correlation ambiguous.
'Hub promise $122.99' introduces subtle cognitive alarm and unfamiliar jargon without inline progressive disclosure.
Capacity metric ('Instant: send up to $182.99, receive up to $23.30') is low-contrast and competes directly with the primary action buttons.
fixes: Differentiate legend indicators: solid green for On-chain, outlined emerald for Reserve, patterned/cyan for Secured.
Add an informational tooltip or badge explaining 'Hub promise' as counterparty credit backed by hub signature.
Increase font weight and contrast of the capacity subline, placing it on its own pill container.

top_issues: WETH balance card at top is cut off abruptly without persistent context header on scroll.
The absolute-scale bar under recent transactions (e.g., under Sent -$25.00) sits detached near the bottom border, looking like an incomplete progress loader rather than an amount indicator.
Accounts card shows '+95.00 owes you' with small send/receive capacity text that lacks visual anchor.
fixes: Stick a compressed top bar on scroll showing network/account status.
Anchor transaction amount scale bars directly under the numeric amounts with a label prefix or subtle track.
Standardize Account card capacity numbers into tabular dual-column chips.

top_issues: Primary action button 'Pay 25.00 USDC' is pushed partially below viewport fold on standard mobile screens.
Route choices ('You -> H1 -> H2') dominate vertical real estate before confirming final destination and recipient alias.
Raw hex address under recipient H2 is truncated awkwardly without quick-copy or explorer preview.
fixes: Make bottom button sticky on mobile viewport above the fold.
Collapse multi-hop route details into an expandable accordion defaulting to best-fee summary.
Add tap-to-copy or modal sheet for the full counterparty entity hex.

top_issues: Scrolled view completely detaches payment input from recipient identity card at top.
'Add a note' is demoted to a tiny text link that can be easily missed.
Selected route border in bright blue outline has minimal visual contrast difference against the unselected dark card.
fixes: Keep compact sticky header with 'Paying H2: 25.00 USDC' on scroll.
Elevate 'Add note' into a visible outlined pill field above payment confirmation.
Add explicit checkmark icon and 2px distinct accent border on active route card.

top_issues: 'Verified by your runtime' green indicator is subtle and lacks tappable proof bundle inspection.
Receipt modal scrim obscures background without showing whether the underlying balance has settled.
Proof hash is truncated ('0x921f4bda...deb9') with no direct tap-to-verify action.
fixes: Make 'Verified by your runtime' an interactive badge opening verified Merkle root and cosignature signatures.
Show updated balance preview badge directly inside receipt header.
Add direct 'Copy hash' inline icon next to truncated proof string.

top_issues: Receipt sheet on scrolled background leaves confusing visual clutter peeking over modal top.
'Done' and 'Copy receipt' action buttons are identical in height but diverge in visual weight, making primary path slightly ambiguous.
Settlement time shows 'in 9 s' in green which could be misinterpreted as time remaining rather than elapsed latency.
fixes: Increase modal scrim opacity to 0.75 or render receipt as full-bleed view on mobile.
Clarify latency label to 'Settled in 9s' explicitly.
Add secondary share sheet button for external audit sharing.

top_issues: QR code container has sharp high-contrast white background that clashes with dark theme background.
Capacity metric ('45.50 capacity via H1') is separated from amount input and hard for novices to understand.
'Prepare incoming account' dropdown implies manual infrastructure overhead to simply receive money.
fixes: Use rounded corners with softer off-white container or dark-themed QR with proper quiet zone.
Add helper text explaining inbound channel capacity in plain language.
Rename 'Prepare incoming account' to 'Receiving channel / Hub'.

top_issues: Full entity id string ('0x7dbe58b7...') is overwhelming and wraps over three lines of monospace text.
Three competing copy buttons ('Copy invoice', 'Copy link', 'Copy xln:// app link') confuse user on which to send.
'Payments arrive instantly up to your inbound room' uses insider terminology ('inbound room').
fixes: Truncate Entity ID with a single clean copy chip.
Consolidate copy actions into a primary 'Share link' and secondary 'Copy ID/Invoice'.
Replace 'inbound room' with 'inbound receiving limit'.

top_issues: Collateral vs Credit slider ('Prepare to receive') introduces steep cognitive overhead into a standard token swap.
'Need 0.039191 WETH more' creates false panic that user lacks funds when it is an inbound capacity/collateral constraint.
Dense metadata table (Limit price, Hub fee, Route, Settlement, Lot rounding) crowds mobile viewport.
fixes: Collapse collateral configuration into an 'Advanced routing / Trust' expandable section.
Clarify 'Need X more' to 'Hub collateral required: X' with clear default safe preset.
Prioritize effective exchange rate and slippage over technical lot rounding lines.

top_issues: Order book bids/asks bar lengths look nearly identical in mobile width, reducing instant depth perception.
Top of screen is cut off mid-spread without displaying the primary swap action button.
Small tap targets for individual price levels on small mobile touch screens.
fixes: Increase proportional depth bar scaling against cumulative volume rather than raw level size.
Provide sticky order summary bar when scrolling the book.
Enlarge tap targets for book rows to minimum 44px height.

top_issues: Action grid has asymmetric layout (2 buttons on top row, 2 on second row, leaving an empty hole on the right).
Color legend ('collateral', 'at risk', 'you owe', 'credit room', 'in flight') uses tiny labels with faint colored dots.
Multi-asset accounts repeat identical nested table headers, wasting vertical space.
fixes: Reorganize action buttons into a balanced 4-column icon bar or 3-column equal grid.
Convert dot legend into interactive pill filters with count badges.
Group token balances under unified account header.

top_issues: Explanatory footer text ('Every frame here is signed by both of you...') is small low-contrast gray text.
'Show 1 empty lane · USDT' is easy to miss as a flat text button.
Lack of explicit CTA to add collateral or rebalance directly from account sheet.
fixes: Elevate protocol invariant explanation into a styled security card.
Style empty lanes as dotted placeholder cards with '+' icon.
Add quick 'Deposit collateral' action button inside account detail.

top_issues: Filter pills row ('All', 'Payments', 'Swaps', 'Settlement', 'Accou...') is truncated horizontally without scroll indicator.
Absolute scale bars under transactions are thin lines floating detached below timestamp.
Timestamp precision is limited to seconds without date separation for older events.
fixes: Add soft fade gradient on right edge of filter pills to indicate horizontal scrolling.
Integrate scale indicator bar into amount column or item background.
Group events by clean sticky date headers ('Today', 'Yesterday').

top_issues: Truncated proof hash ('0x921f4bda...7bdeb9') has no inline copy icon or link to raw frame inspector.
Modal card title 'RECEIPT' and status 'PAYMENT · SETTLED' duplicate semantic status.
'2 committed entries' lacks direct link to inspect the individual ledger state transitions.
fixes: Add explicit 'Copy proof' and 'View frame bundle' actions.
Clean header hierarchy to single clear settled badge and prominent amount.
Make '2 committed entries' clickable to expand individual transitions.

top_issues: Scale configuration slider ('Dollars per pixel') is positioned as the very first setting, intimidating non-technical users.
Dense conceptual text explaining absolute scale ('Every bar in the wallet is drawn to this one scale...') clutters settings.
Toggle list items have lengthy subtext that causes heavy visual fatigue.
fixes: Move 'Dollars per pixel' scale settings to Appearance or Advanced sub-menu.
Use compact visual preview widget instead of long paragraph explanation.
Shorten descriptions under toggle switches to one concise line.

top_issues: 'At this scale' visualizer displays lines exceeding card boundaries by design, which can look broken on mobile screens.
'Forget vault' destructive action is styled as a plain button directly below recovery phrase.
Runtime ID is shown as unformatted raw hex string.
fixes: Cap scale visualizer bars with explicit right overflow fade and end-cap arrow.
Place 'Forget vault' in a separated danger zone card with confirmation modal requirement.
Add one-tap copy button next to Runtime ID.

top_issues: FROM and TO cards use identical 3-card horizontal rows ('Wallet', 'Reserve', 'Account') causing severe visual repetition.
Selected states in FROM and TO are hard to distinguish from unselected states.
Form requires scrolling down to find the submission button.
fixes: Replace repeated 3x2 card matrix with intuitive segmented source/destination selector or interactive transfer diagram.
Add prominent active border and check badge to chosen source and destination.
Pin 'Sign & send' button to viewport bottom.

top_issues: Top cards are cut off, losing context of which direction transfer is going.
'Add to batch' button sits next to 'Sign & send' with equal visual presence despite being niche power-user functionality.
'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' is confusing placeholder text in a self-custodial transfer.
fixes: Show sticky transfer summary pill ('Reserve -> H1 Account') when scrolled.
Demote 'Add to batch' to secondary outlined styling or overflow menu.
Replace placeholder text with toggle: 'Self' vs 'External Entity'.

top_issues: Top grid of navigation tiles has uneven 2-column layout ending in an orphaned full-width card ('Ownership').
'Where your money stands' card provides exceptional mental model clarity but is pushed down by the tile grid.
'Promised by hubs' in violet carries vague risk without an immediate 1-tap rebalance action.
fixes: Promote 'Where your money stands' summary to top of screen above navigation tiles.
Refactor navigation tiles into balanced list or uniform grid.
Add quick action 'Settle promises' button directly on 'Promised by hubs' row.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' subtext under each asset is cryptographically precise but confusing to regular users.
Zero-balance assets take up significant vertical room without hide/collapse option.
Faucet section is cut off at bottom of screen.
fixes: Replace 'Depository may pull' with clear 'Approved allowance' label.
Add 'Hide zero balances' toggle.
Group faucets into a clean bottom banner card.

top_issues: Screen cuts off in the middle of collateral slider and action buttons.
Confusing message: 'Collateral for a future receipt is not available yet. No fee is charged. You can explicitly choose credit, or wait for collateral support.'
Stack of four dark buttons at bottom creates decision paralysis with ambiguous hierarchy.
fixes: Streamline receive flow so collateral options are hidden behind single safe recommended route.
Rephrase warning into actionable choice dialog.
Consolidate multiple destination buttons into a single primary action with segmented destination picker.

top_issues: Token selection cards ('USDC', 'WETH', 'USDT') create an awkward 2-column uneven grid.
'Lend' and 'Borrow' tabs are placed awkwardly beneath token selection rather than at screen top.
Interest rate input is denominated in 'basis points' (100 = 1.00%), which is alienating for consumer users.
fixes: Move Lend/Borrow segmented control to top of page.
Render token selection as a clean horizontal scrolling rail or dropdown.
Allow direct percentage input (e.g., '1.0%') while showing basis points as technical subtext.

top_issues: H1 Pool statistics card shows all zeroes with minimal contextual benchmark.
'Offer to the pool' button is disabled/active state contrast is subtle.
Explanatory subtext under button is small low-contrast gray text.
fixes: Show current market APY and active pool utilization percentage.
Increase primary CTA button prominence with high-contrast text.
Add breakdown of collateral backing borrower loans in the pool.

top_issues: 'Lazy (hash of its board)' governance jargon is cryptic without prior protocol spec knowledge.
Board threshold shows '1 of 1' with no button or affordance to add signers or upgrade governance.
Secondary card 'Take control of another entity' is passive empty state text.
fixes: Add info tooltip explaining lazy off-chain multisig vs on-chain registered entities.
Add clear '+ Add co-signer / threshold' action button for DAO governance.
Replace empty state card with 'Scan/import board invitation' button.

top_issues: Header highlights 'Enforceable right now $40.00' in green, which contrasts sharply with total balance and can induce panic if user forgets $97.99 is in hub promise.
Four legend dots have very subtle hue distinctions on small screens.
Bottom action 'Save evidence bundle' is pushed towards fold.
fixes: Present total balance side-by-side with enforceable balance so user sees total net worth intact.
Use icon badges (shield, lock, chain) instead of plain color dots for legend categories.
Pin 'Save evidence bundle' to screen bottom.

top_issues: 'Can dispute without asking: 1 of 1' is dense protocol phrasing.
'they answer in 1 d, you in 1 d' dispute window notation needs explicit challenge period explanation.
Tapping 'Save evidence bundle' doesn't specify export format (JSON, zip, signed frame WAL).
fixes: Rephrase to 'Autonomous dispute ready: 1 account fully armed'.
Add visual timeline bar showing the 24h challenge/response window.
Label CTA 'Export signed proof bundle (.json)'.

overall.verdict: xln wallet delivers an exceptional, mathematically rigorous dark-mode mobile interface with unmatched structural honesty around bilateral state, absolute scaling, and on-chain enforceability. Its chief weakness is exposing deep consensus plumbing (basis points, raw frame counts, lazy entities, and hub promises) directly into consumer payment and swap paths.
priority_fixes: Hide advanced bilateral collateral and capacity tuning behind a progressive disclosure toggle on Pay and Swap screens so consumer flows stay under 10 seconds.
Pin primary transaction CTA buttons ('Pay', 'Sign & send', 'Save evidence bundle') above mobile navigation bar to avoid keyboard and scroll clipping.
Differentiate balance swatch legends using distinct geometric icons (chain, vault, promise) rather than multiple identical green dots.
Replace cryptographic jargon ('inbound room', 'lazy board', 'basis points') with clear banking/settlement analogies across all entry cards.
Consolidate multi-copy actions on Receive into a single universal 'Share invoice' action sheet.
